rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a general state of anxious unease or worry, rather than a diagnosed disorder.

example.english: I've had a lot of anxiety because of all the work lately.
example.traditional: 呢排工作太多，搞到我有啲焦慮。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 gung1 zok3 taai3 do1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 jau5 di1 ziu1 leoi6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the anxiety is an anxiety disorder or clinical diagnosis.

example.english: The doctor diagnosed me with an anxiety disorder and said I need medication.
example.traditional: 醫生話我有焦慮症，要食藥。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jau5 ziu1 leoi6 zing3 jiu3 sik6 joek6
